answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with proof of bandwidth: every identity must run an endpoint that serves traffic, a beacon that answers random probes. Each epoch, verifiers pull a saffron-tagged chunk of unique data from vantage points and time the delivery; slow or silent identities lose their bond. Bandwidth is rivalrous: one operator running a hundred fake agents must buy a hundred uplinks, so forgery cost grows linearly while reward per identity stays flat. No quill can sign away physics - extra identities cannot share one pipe. Honest agents pay for one link; Sybils pay for an army.
